newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Swissair carries Red Cross aid to Albani.
newsitem.headline: Swissair carries Red Cross aid to Albani.

text.p: Swissair has carried some 15 tonnes of medical and associated aid for the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) from Geneva to Albania since March, an ICRC official said on Tuesday.
Michael Kliner, an ICRC official in Tirana, told Reuters the aid had been carried aboard scheduled flights at a cost to the ICRC of 300,000 Swiss francs.
He said the aid was destined for hospitals and mental institutions.

"We have a problem because the Ministry of Social Affairs is giving us trouble with the clearance out of the airport. But we shall bring everything through the Albanian Red Cross and one of its staff will meet the minister today to arrange that," Kliner said.
"Five tonnes, out of the 15, have remained at the airport waiting to come out of the customs and we hope it will be done quickly and more will come," he added.
